quizzes.title: Science Basics
quizzes.description: Core facts: inventors, cells, and the scientific method.

questions.prompt: Which completes the statement? Gravity was formulated by ____.
questions.source: Gravity was formulated by Isaac Newton.

questions.prompt: The printing press was invented in ____.
questions.source: The printing press was invented in 1440.

questions.prompt: The nucleus is the organelle that stores the genetic material.
questions.source: The nucleus is the organelle that stores the genetic material.

questions.prompt: Penicillin was discovered by Marie Curie.
questions.source: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming.

questions.prompt: A ____ is an organelle that produces energy.
questions.source: A mitochondrion is an organelle that produces energy.
Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming.

questions.prompt: Match each organelle to what it does.
Define photosynthesis in your own words.
questions.reference: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert light energy into chemical energy.

questions.prompt: List the steps stated in the source for the scientific method.
questions.reference: Ask a question, form a hypothesis, conduct an experiment, and analyze the results.

quizzes.title: Words & Everyday Science
quizzes.description: Terms, measurements, and states of matter.

questions.prompt: Which organelle stores the genetic material?
questions.source: The nucleus is the organelle that stores the genetic material.

questions.prompt: Which part carries out computer instructions?
questions.source: The CPU carries out computer instructions.

questions.prompt: Water boils at ____ degrees Celsius at sea level.
questions.source: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
RAM stands for Random Access Memory.

questions.prompt: Match each term to its meaning.
